ModMetaData.name: Warband Generals (Community)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Romance-of-the-Three-Kingdoms flavour for Rim War: NPC warbands get named generals.

- Newly raised warbands have a chance to be led by a named general with Might and Command stats (Named Officers foundation layer).
- Generals swing abstract battles: a strong general deals more and takes less point damage, applied locally per battle round (faction-level stats are never touched).
- The warband inspect pane shows the general and a stat summary.
- Victorious generals carry over to the regrouped warband; generals whose warband is wiped out are removed.

Requires Harmony, Rim War and Named Officers (Community). Safe to add to existing saves.
